s: Seville (the capital city of Andalusia, Spain)
Sevilla.et: Borrowed from Spanish Sevilla, from Arabic إِشْبِيلِيَة (ʔišbīliya), from Latin Hispalis, ultimately from Phoenician 𐤔𐤐𐤋𐤄 (šplh /⁠sefela⁠/, “plain, valley”).

s: a male given name from Latin Severinus
